note: t=caps: NZBHydra2 9.1.1's own Newznab API with no indexer configured (every Usenet indexer needs an account). Installed from: nzbhydra2-9.1.1-windows.zip from github.com: SHA-256 matched the vendor's published checksum.

reply.bodyText:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<caps xmlns:atom="http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom"  xmlns:newznab="http://www.newznab.com/DTD/2010/feeds/attributes/">
    <server title="NZBHydra 2" email="user@example.test" url="https://github.com/theotherp/nzbhydra2" image="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/theotherp/nzbhydra2/master/core/src/main/resources/static/img/banner-bright.png"/>
    <limits max="100" default="100"/>
    <retention days="3000"/>
    <searching>
        <search available="yes" supportedParams="q,cat,limit,offset,minage,maxage,minsize,maxsize"/>
        <tv-search available="yes" supportedParams="q,season,ep,cat,limit,offset,minage,maxage,minsize,maxsize,rid,tvdbid,tvmazeid,imdbid,traktid"/>
        <movie-search available="yes" supportedParams="q,cat,limit,offset,minage,maxage,minsize,maxsize,imdbid,tmdbid"/>
        <audio-search available="no" supportedParams=""/>
        <book-search available="no" supportedParams=""/>
    </searching>
    <categories>
        <category id="1000" name="Console"/>
        <category id="2000" name="Movies">
            <subcat id="2040" name="Movies HD"/>
            <subcat id="2030" name="Movies SD"/>
        </category>
        <category id="3000" name="Audio">
            <subcat id="3030" name="Audiobook"/>
            <subcat id="3040" name="FLAC"/>
            <subcat id="3010" name="MP3"/>
        </category>
        <category id="4000" name="PC"/>
        <category id="5000" name="TV">
            <subcat id="5070" name="Anime"/>
            <subcat id="5040" name="TV HD"/>
            <subcat id="5030" name="TV SD"/>
        </category>
        <category id="6000" name="XXX"/>
        <category id="7020" name="Ebook"/>
        <category id="7030" name="Comic"/>
    </categories>
</caps>
